description: A >= 6 remainder of bean qou-brng after qou-m8f3 (PR #7200): the trace's dominant summand argmax|y_lambda chi^lambda| is a TWO-ROW block at 6Li/7Li, whose character is not a ring homomorphism. For every typed cluster (Z,N) with Z+N <= 7 on the live alternating-core atom word (proton pin, convention D): the dominant block and its margin; fixed-n chain-edge additivity of the same-block log ratio for every block; the typed bond-set (interface-subset) Moebius cumulants of the dominant block's log-weight at 6Li (all 32 subsets) and 7Li (singletons, pairs, full); the typed Ursell inversion to order 7; uniform-e2 at A <= 4 and per-cluster totals vs AME2020. Controls: the one-row block (letter product, zero cumulants) and the full trace (bond rule, zero cumulants). Nothing wired, nothing fitted, no route selected by residual.
